forecast_entity.name: Forecast Entity
forecast_entity.description: A weather.* entity that provides forecast data (e.g. weather.pirateweather). Must have daily forecast attributes.

station_entity.name: Station Entity
station_entity.description: An optional weather.* entity for current conditions from a local weather station (e.g. weather.my_station). Leave empty to use the forecast entity for current conditions too.

weatheralerts_entity.name: Weather Alerts Entity
weatheralerts_entity.description: An optional weatheralerts integration entity (e.g. weatheralerts.my_alerts). When active alerts are present, the humidity column is replaced with an alert severity icon and 3-letter event code. Leave empty to disable.

radar_zoom.name: Radar Zoom Level
radar_zoom.description: Map zoom level for the radar view (1 = wide, 7 = close). Default: 6.

show_time.name: Show Time
show_time.description: Show the current time in the header. Turn off to display only the date and day of week, useful when the GIF stays on screen a long time and a frozen clock would look stale. Default: on.

date_format.name: Date Format
date_format.description: How the header date is displayed. Use MM for month and DD for day; any other characters (such as -, ., or /) are literal separators. Years are not supported. Examples: MM-DD, DD.MM., MM/DD. Default: MM-DD.

time_format.name: Time Format
time_format.description: 12-hour clock with AM/PM (12h) or 24-hour clock (24h). Also applies to the radar frame timestamps. Default: 12h.
